title: QueuedEvent
description: The wire shape of a queued outbox event, derived from identity_cloudflare::queue::QueuedEvent. This is the body placed on Cloudflare Queues: a struct rather than the bare OutboxEvent, because the queue body is a contract that outlives any Rust type. The payload is opaque here; its schema belongs to the event type's version.
x-serde-status: IMPLEMENTED as a wire shape (Cloudflare adapter). The type is defined and serialised; producers and consumers are DEFERRED to Phase 7.

id.description: The idempotency key. Minted at write time and never re-minted, so every delivery of the same fact carries the same id. Empty is refused; not a UUID is refused by the adapter's parsed_id() boundary.
id.x-note: The key is the canonical text form of OutboxEventId (minted at write time), not regenerated at dispatch.

event_type.description: The versioned message type, e.g. identity.email.send.v1. Must end with .vN (digits). An unknown or malformed type is not recognised by consumers.

occurred_at_ms.description: When the fact was committed, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

payload.description: The body. Opaque here; its shape belongs to the event type's version. The OutboxEvent stores it as serde_json::Value.

x-versioning: Version is encoded in the event_type suffix (.vN). Consumers must refuse unknown types rather than guessing.
x-phase: Phase 7 — Background work (the wire shape exists; dispatch/consumers deferred)
